title: The Armory
description: The armory has a wide assortment of armor displayed on the walls and in the windows. Helmets, shields, and suits of armor are for sale. To the north is the main street. On the wall is a small note.
npcs: A Peacekeeper is standing here, ready to jump in at the first sign of trouble.
An armorer stands here displaying his new (and previously owned) armors.
